title: The Private Files of Rex Saunders
paragraphs: Short-lived NBC detective/adventure vehicle starring Rex Harrison as Rex Saunders with Leon Janney as assistant Alec. Frozen collection has thirteen regular broadcast recordings plus the April 13 Game With Death audition; the regular May 23 episode-4 slot lacks a distinct frozen network aircheck.

GRH documents the program through Game With Death audition (April 13, 1951 to April 13, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] and NBC/RCA Victor regular run (May 2, 1951 to August 1, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Edward Adamson (writer on 14 recordings), Himan Brown (director on 14 recordings), Leon Janney (performer on 14 recordings), Rex Harrison (performer on 14 recordings), Kenneth Banghart (announcer on 13 recordings), Alice Frost (performer on 2 recordings), and Amzie Strickland (performer on 2 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include murder and criminal plots, Rex Saunders and Alec partnership, private detective investigation, celebrity star vehicle, RCA Victor sponsored network radio, and edited/syndicated preservation copy.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Rex Harrison radio star vehicle, Edited Rex Saunders preservation copies, 1951 NBC/RCA Victor Rex Saunders run, and April 1951 Game With Death audition.
plain_text:
Short-lived NBC detective/adventure vehicle starring Rex Harrison as Rex Saunders with Leon Janney as assistant Alec. Frozen collection has thirteen regular broadcast recordings plus the April 13 Game With Death audition; the regular May 23 episode-4 slot lacks a distinct frozen network aircheck.

GRH documents the program through Game With Death audition (April 13, 1951 to April 13, 1951) on NBC Radio Network and NBC/RCA Victor regular run (May 2, 1951 to August 1, 1951) on NBC Radio Network.

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Edward Adamson (writer on 14 recordings), Himan Brown (director on 14 recordings), Leon Janney (performer on 14 recordings), Rex Harrison (performer on 14 recordings), Kenneth Banghart (announcer on 13 recordings), Alice Frost (performer on 2 recordings), and Amzie Strickland (performer on 2 recordings).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include murder and criminal plots, Rex Saunders and Alec partnership, private detective investigation, celebrity star vehicle, RCA Victor sponsored network radio, and edited/syndicated preservation copy.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Rex Harrison radio star vehicle, Edited Rex Saunders preservation copies, 1951 NBC/RCA Victor Rex Saunders run, and April 1951 Game With Death audition.
